Package controller

Class StudentController

java.lang.Object
controller.StudentController
public class StudentController extends Object
Controller responsible for handling all business logic for a Student user. This includes viewing available internships, applying for them, accepting offers, and withdrawing applications.
Version:
1.0

    • StudentController

      public StudentController(IDataStore inputStore, Session inputSession)
      Constructs a new StudentController.
      Parameters:
      inputStore - The main IDataStore containing all application data.
      inputSession - The Session object, which must contain a logged-in Student user.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the user in the session is not an instance of Student.

  • Method Details

    • getApplications

      public List<Application> getApplications(ApplicationStatus status, boolean filledCheck)
      Gets a list of this student's applications, filtered by status.
      Parameters:
      status - The ApplicationStatus to filter by, or null for all.
      filledCheck - If true, applications for FILLED internships are excluded.
      Returns:
      A list of Application objects.

    • getWithdrawableApplications

      public List<Application> getWithdrawableApplications()
      Gets a list of all applications this student can currently withdraw from. Excludes applications that are already WITHDRAWN or UNSUCCESSFUL.
      Returns:
      A list of withdrawable Application objects.

    • getAvailableInternships

      public List<Internship> getAvailableInternships()
      Gets a list of all internships the student is eligible to apply for *right now*. This applies strict, non-user-configurable business rules.
      Returns:
      A list of available Internship objects.

    • getFilteredInternships

      public List<Internship> getFilteredInternships()
      Gets a list of internships based on the student's saved filter preferences (studentFilterPreference).
      Returns:
      A list of Internship objects matching the user's filter.

    • CreateApplications

      public boolean CreateApplications(int internshipId)
      Creates a new application for an internship.
      Parameters:
      internshipId - The ID of the internship to apply for.
      Returns:
      true if the application was created successfully, false if the internship is not available or the student has already applied.

    • AcceptApplications

      public boolean AcceptApplications(int applicationId)
      Accepts a SUCCESSFUL internship offer. This action sets the application status to ACCEPTED, increments the internship's filled slot count, and forcibly withdraws all other "withdrawable" applications for this student.
      Parameters:
      applicationId - The ID of the SUCCESSFUL application to accept.
      Returns:
      true if successful, false if the application was not found, not in SUCCESSFUL state, or the internship is already FILLED.

    • WithdrawApplication

      public boolean WithdrawApplication(int applicationId)
      Submits a request to withdraw an application. This sets a flag on the application that must be approved by Career Staff.
      Parameters:
      applicationId - The ID of the application to withdraw.
      Returns:
      true if the request was submitted, false if the application was not found, does not belong to the student, or is already in a final state (UNSUCCESSFUL or WITHDRAWN).

    • getStudentFilterPreferences

      public InternshipFilter getStudentFilterPreferences()
      Gets the InternshipFilter object used for the "View Internships" feature. This allows the UI to modify the filter's properties directly.
      Returns:
      The InternshipFilter instance used by this controller.

    • filterClear

      public final void filterClear()
      Resets the student's internship filter to the default, role-based criteria. This applies all base-level constraints (APPROVED, visible, major, date, level).
